summary_of_pdf: The provided document is an RPost Registered Email receipt serving as cryptographic, verifiable proof of delivery and actual notice. It confirms the successful transmission, delivery, and opening of an email sent by RJ Aguiar to an attorney at Orrick on April 7, 2026. The underlying communication constitutes an inquiry for intellectual property representation concerning a 47-patent portfolio and parallel federal disclosures implicating eBay and UBER.
attorneys_comments: As senior litigation counsel, I note that this RPost receipt provides highly reliable, court-admissible evidence of delivery and actual notice under the Federal Rules of Evidence (FRE 901). The verifiable timestamps (UTC and local) and IP address tracking establish an indisputable timeline of notice to Orrick counsel, foreclosing any plausible deniability regarding the receipt of the representation inquiry and the enclosed disclosures. Tactically, if this relates to prospective litigation against eBay or UBER, this receipt solidifies the date of actual knowledge for the receiving party. This is highly relevant for establishing a timeline for willful infringement claims under 35 U.S.C. § 284, triggering duties to prospective clients under ABA Model Rule 1.18, and potentially implicating SEC material risk disclosure obligations depending on the nature of the 'Parallel Federal Disclosures'. The evidentiary strength of this document is robust, provided the native cryptographic attachments are preserved.
recommended_next_steps: Preserve the RPost receipt and its cryptographic attachments in their native electronic format to ensure evidentiary admissibility and authentication under FRE 901. Receiving counsel must immediately conduct a comprehensive conflicts check regarding eBay, UBER, and the referenced 47-patent portfolio. Depending on the conflicts outcome, counsel must formally respond to the prospective client to either accept the engagement or issue a clear, unequivocal non-engagement letter to avoid implied attorney-client relationship liabilities and tolling issues.
